sections.name: Acceptance criteria
sections.explanation: Acceptance criteria and Given/When/Then scenarios are populated, but they are frequently repeated across different user stories or inherited from parent features and business requirements. Some success criteria also contain inherited business-rule measurements rather than validated outcomes for the individual story.
expected_refinement: Define acceptance criteria specific to each user story.
Ensure Given/When/Then scenarios describe the actual behaviour of that story.
Specify clear and testable expected outcomes.
Validate that associated business rules apply to the individual story.
Ensure success criteria demonstrate whether the story has been completed correctly.

sections.name: Dependencies
observations: Some dependency-related information exists in constraints.risks_and_dependencies but is not structured as user-story dependencies.

recommendation.action: Retain the existing 328 user stories. Do not regenerate them from scratch.
recommendation.next_stage: User Story Functional Refinement and Validation
